style: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment illustration for Panlibrarium, a dark fantasy deckbuilding videogame. Painterly oil and gouache, rich textured brushwork, aged brass, midnight ink blue, warm amber light, coherent with illustrated fantasy cards. Landscape 3:2. Strong readable focal subject in central 70 percent, atmospheric depth, detailed crafted environment. No typography, no letters, no numbers, no interface, no border, no watermark. Non-graphic fantasy, adult fully clothed characters. Make an actual scene, not a card or UI mockup.

subjects.atlas: An enormous ancient open atlas on a carved brass cartographer's table, islands and mountains sculpted from parchment emerging from its pages, faint golden pathways linking miniature towers, luminous blue ink rivers, candlelight, a compass at the margin. Seen from a high angled perspective, empty quiet middle area for a game route overlay. No drawn symbols or lettering.
subjects.merchant: A charismatic elderly travelling merchant with warm brown skin, grey braided beard, round brass spectacles and richly layered plum and amber robes, standing behind a wooden curiosity stall in an impossible vaulted library. Potions, sealed relics and magical books displayed on the counter; lanterns and hanging brass scales, welcoming and mysterious. Merchant face clearly visible upper center, counter lower third.
subjects.rest: A peaceful emerald spring inside an abandoned library conservatory, luminous healing water falling from a moss-covered marble basin, cushions, old books and small candles, moonlight through tall arched windows, a sheltered oasis for weary adventurers.
subjects.forge: A magical bookbinder's workshop in a vaulted library, an illuminated open book on a massive carved desk, hovering blue ink threads binding and reinforcing its pages, brass press and exquisite quills, blue and amber sparks, no human subject.
